'''Fire Surge''' is a [[Fire spells|fire]]-based [[Surge spells|surge spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 95 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest fire spell in the game, and the highest-level combat spell in the standard spellbook.

==Damage==
Fire Surge has a base maximum hit of 24. As with all combat spells, this is increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a fire-based spell, Fire Surge's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to fire]].
